scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder
Explained how this shared folder causes the signing conflict

scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, error-free investigation with an accurate literal report of the Distrib property and double writes, but it missed the actual root cause. It affirmatively denied any shared output directory despite a clear hint from the tool that unset properties may still inherit the same default, and offered a plausible-sounding but likely incorrect alternate explanation involving an obj-directory double write unrelated to the signing path.
